#   FireHOL IP Blocklist › Sblam!
#   
#   This blocklist is sourced from FireHOL and aggregates IP addresses
#   from the Sblam! project.
#   
#   Sblam! is a service that effectively secures forms for comments on blogs,
#   forums and guest books before spam : advertisements for drugs, porn,
#   casinos and other junk messages mass-sent by bots. Automatically detects
#   and rejects unwanted messages in a way that is invisible to normal users.
#   
#   As of May 2026, this list is no longer being updated by Sblam. IPs within
#   this list will grow static and unchanged.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
